facts.business: Spectrum Foods Limited is engaged in the business of Salt, Refinery, Hospitality, and Renewable Energy.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Revenue Recognition for Salt business due to different pricing structures, voluminous customers, unbilled revenue estimation, billing software usage, and data reconciliation issues with billing software.

key_risks: Accuracy of revenue recognition and measurement for salt business due to different pricing structures, voluminous customers, unbilled revenue estimation, and billing software reliance
Data of billing software regarding recovery and overdue amounts under reconciliation with financial books
Domestic debtors taken as per books without confirmation due to huge number
Economic conditions, changes in government regulations, tax regime, market forces
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions entered during the year were in Ordinary Course of Business and on Arm's Length basis. There were related Party Transactions exceeding ten percent of the annual consolidated turnover. Prior omnibus approval of Audit Committee obtained for foreseeable and repetitive transactions. Particulars in Form AOC-2 provided as Annexure C.
